title: The Book of Joshua, Metsudah Publications, 1997
text: That the Bnei Yisroel struck. In the days [lifetime] of Moshe.
To the Yabok river, which was the border of the land of the Bnei Amon, the end of the territory of the land of Bnei Amon. From there [the Yabok River] and further the Bnei Amon had dominion.
Half of the Gilod, the boundry of Sichon. That was the border of Sichon’s domain, as we said above,1See Verse 2. that half of Gilod was his, and this second half was Og’s.
The Dor region. The provinces of Dor.
